title: Findings manifest — machine-readable mirror of the report's findings
description: Emitted by the threat-model run alongside the markdown report. The eval validates structure, internal consistency (severity == band(L x I)), grounding (refs resolve to recon), and coverage — none of which need a per-target answer key. Control-coverage is a reference-free per-finding property (disposition-vs-controls consistency + zero-control flagging with honest abstention), never an answer key that a control is the correct remediation; controls[]/control_disposition/disposition_note are optional and additive so a findings manifest predating them still validates.

stride_lm.description: STRIDE-LM categories; a finding may legitimately span several

cvss_vector.description: optional CVSS v3.1 exploitability vector (AV/AC/PR/UI) decomposing this Likelihood; null or omitted when the Likelihood was not decomposed. The eval recomputes 8.22*AV*AC*PR*UI over this vector and asserts it bands to the stated likelihood (see frameworks.md).

cwe.description: null or omitted when the finding maps to no CWE

mitre.description: null or omitted when the finding maps to no ATT&CK technique

asset_refs.description: recon component/data_store ids this finding concerns

surface_refs.description: recon entry_point/trust_boundary/external_dep ids this finding covers

controls.description: addressable control objects that remediate this finding (the machine-readable promotion of free-text remediation). Optional and additive — a finding predating this field simply has none, and the eval flags it as control-coverage-unknown without failing the run.

name.description: human control action (the migrated free-text remediation)

framework_ref.description: optional normalized NIST-800-53 (e.g. SC-7, AC-3(4)) or D3FEND (e.g. D3-NTA) control id; null or omitted when no normalized id applies (the action stays in name). Format-checked only; mapping correctness is agent-verified against frameworks.md, never asserted by the eval.

counters.description: RESERVED for the attack-defense-tree change: attack-node ids this control interdicts. Defaults empty; no grounding is enforced on its members here.

control_disposition.description: optional. mitigated iff >=1 control is attached; accepted-risk / none are honest abstentions that MUST carry a disposition_note. The eval recomputes this from the finding's own controls[] and flags disagreement (see checks.py).

disposition_note.description: required by the eval when control_disposition is accepted-risk / none — the reason the risk is accepted or no control applies (honest-abstention evidence, mirrors the coverage ledger's unknown-needs-a-note rule).

no_issue_surface.description: recon surface ids deliberately judged to carry no finding (so coverage can distinguish 'examined, clean' from 'missed')

kill_chains.description: multi-step attack chains the analysis identified (the LLM's judgment). Verification requires an attack tree and attack-flow per declared chain; the eval never clusters findings itself.

goal.description: the attacker objective at the root of the chain
